facts: About 643,000 people in the municipality (2021), urban area over 3.6 million
The southernmost capital on the European mainland
worth_knowing: Recorded history spans over 3,400 years. By Greek mythology the city was named after Athena, though modern scholars generally think the goddess took her name from the city.
